Trump Exempts Select Canadian Imports From 50% Tariffs
The White House said that Trump’s order exempts certain plywood sheets, paper products, machinery, refrigeration equipment, packing materials and fresh and dried seaweed from the tariffs.
The changes take effect Oct. 30, four days

However, Trump also added other Canadian products to the 50% tariff list, including carpets, paints, shampoos, cocoa powder, wooden coffins, air conditioners, chest freezers, archery equipment and canoes.
Collins welcomed the relief, saying it would benefit Maine’s blueberry, potato, apple and seaweed industries, Reuters reported.

“Many of our farmers and growers rely on specialized equipment, packaging materials and other ​products from Canada,” said Collins, adding that alternatives could be unavailable or significantly more expensive.
